summary: End-to-end verification of ported Intrinsic Technology app. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass (health, root, auth login/me/unauth, content endpoints, inquiries submit+list, blog CRUD, sitemap, robots, brief-download, SSR). Frontend: Home + all primary routes (/services/ai, /services/cybersecurity, /services/cloud, /services/managed-it, /services/ai-governance-compliance, /services/security-governance-compliance, /industries, /industries/healthcare, /about, /resources, /careers, /contact, case-studies/:slug) render with correct titles, no page errors. Unknown route renders NotFound page. Contact form submission (POST /api/inquiries) succeeds and inquiry appears in admin dashboard. Admin login with seeded credentials works, dashboard shows submissions and content sections, logout control visible. SSR, sitemap.xml, robots.txt all return valid content.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (backend) appears monolithic and large - consider splitting routers by domain (content, auth, inquiries, SEO, admin, storage) for maintainability.
Transient 502s observed during first few requests of a cold session (ingress/pod warm-up) - subsequent requests OK; may want keep-alive/warmup probe in production.
EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY not set so inquiry notifications are not emailed - documented as expected in review request. Backend still persists inquiries correctly.

No blog posts seeded by default (api/content/blogs returned empty); blog post route tested only via admin-created transient post (CRUD passed). Consider seeding at least one published blog for public /blog/:slug coverage.
seed_data_creation: Submitted 1 TEST contact inquiry via UI (TEST_First TEST_Last / test_ui_contact@example.com), 1 TEST inquiry via pytest, 1 TEST brief-download, and transient blog CRUD (created+deleted). TEST inquiries remain in DB - prefix TEST_ for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Routes for services are under /services/<slug> not top-level. Admin login uses data-testid=login-email, login-password, login-submit. Contact form on /contact uses data-testid=contact-input-{first,last,company,email,phone,message} and form data-testid=contact-form. Brief download requires brief_id (not 'brief') and 'message' fields; valid brief_ids obtainable from GET /api/content/service-briefs. The frontend seems to use CRACO; hot reload works. Public base URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env.
